name: Shinoda Kouta
source:
An exorcist who helps people troubled by evil spirits and monsters. Blessed with such talent since he was young, he learned many techniques at a young age. He was strange and standoffish as a child, but grew up into a talented exorcist.

He's a straightforward and honest man, who tries to see the good in everyone. Because of his purity of heart, he can seem a little ditzy at times.
